featured.title: Accelerator Workshop India 2026
featured.body: In collaboration with Isha Outreach. 19 to 30 October 2026 at Save Soil Farm, near the Isha Yoga Center, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Our first workshop on the subcontinent. Hands in soil, microscopes on tables, and a community milestone for the region.
featured.source: school.soilfoodweb.com/courses/india-workshop-2026, the live enrollment page, checked 11 September 2026
featured.note: The copy deck called this the Asia-Pacific Workshop in October 2027 and the old footer said 19 to 30 October. The live sales page says October 2026, and that is what prints here.

otherListings.note: Webinar listings come from webinar.soilfoodweb.com, where the current series includes Vandana Shiva with Evan Buckman, and Dr. Carla Portugal and Dr. Adam Cobb on soil biology and permaculture. Future workshops collect interest at school.soilfoodweb.com/pages/workshop-interest. Still open: the feed format and which system is the source of truth for dates. Evan.
